title: salpichroa tristis var. lehmannii
intro: Salpichroa tristis var. lehmannii, commonly known as Chilean fernbell, is a plant species in the family Solanaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. Its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the Chilean fernbell plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
